title: Dirichlet Process Mixtures within Semiparametric Bayesian Networks: A Novel Conditional Density Estimation Approach
abstract: arXiv:2610.36110v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Semiparametric Bayesian networks (SPBNs) are flexible probabilistic graphical models for representing joint distributions of continuous variables through lower-dimensional conditional probability distributions (CPDs). Existing SPBN models use kernel density estimators (KDEs) for non-parametric CPD modeling, but their one-component-per-observation mixture representation can lead to increased inference costs and density estimation errors, which can be limiting. In this work, we define a new CPD modeling approach for non-parametric components based on Bayesian non-parametric Dirichlet Process Mixtures (DPMs) within SPBNs. DPMs provide a data-adaptive clustering of observations, yielding a more compact representation while retaining the flexibility of non-parametric density estimation, unlike KDE. translated_title: 半参数贝叶斯网络中的狄利克雷过程混合模型：一种新颖的条件密度估计方法
translated_abstract: 半参数贝叶斯网络（SPBN）是一类灵活的概率图模型，通过低维条件概率分布（CPD）来表示连续变量的联合分布。现有的SPBN模型采用核密度估计器（KDE）进行非参数CPD建模，但其“每个观测对应一个混合分量”的表示方式会导致推理成本增加和密度估计误差，这可能成为应用的限制。在这项工作中，我们在SPBN框架内定义了一种基于贝叶斯非参数狄利克雷过程混合模型（DPM）的全新非参数组件CPD建模方法。与KDE不同，DPM能够对观测数据进行自适应聚类，在保留非参数密度估计灵活性的同时，获得更紧凑的表示。这使得推理成本更低，同时提升了密度估计性能。我们通过扩展实现了所提出的基于DPM的半参数贝叶斯网络（DPM-SPBN）。
tldr: 本文提出在半参数贝叶斯网络中用狄利克雷过程混合模型（DPM）替代核密度估计进行非参数条件概率分布建模，通过数据自适应聚类获得更紧凑的表示，在降低推理成本的同时提升了密度估计性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes using Bayesian nonparametric Dirichlet Process Mixtures (DPMs) instead of kernel density estimators for non-parametric CPD modeling within semiparametric Bayesian networks, providing data-adaptive clustering for more compact representations that lower inference costs while improving density estimation performance.
